title: Hölder functions with nonporous graphs
summary: For any $α\in (0,1)$ there is a Hölder continuous function $h:\mathbb{R} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ with nonporous graph $Gr(h) \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ which is thin for doubling measures. Construction of these functions requires analysis of a known example with nonporous graph and bounded variation on the unit interval.
